questions.prompt: Match each ATX wire colour to its voltage.
questions.explanation: Knowing the colours helps you read a PSU and its cables.

questions.prompt: A PSU tester shows +12 V at 11.1 V. What is your conclusion?
choices: It is below the 11.40 V minimum: replace the PSU
questions.explanation: The +12 V output must stay within 11.40–12.60 V.

questions.prompt: A CMOS battery measures 2.4 V. The computer forgets its date and time. What should you do?
questions.explanation: A new CR2032 reads about 3 V; 2.4 V is too weak to keep the settings.

questions.prompt: Which multimeter setting finds a broken wire in an unplugged cable?
questions.explanation: The meter beeps when there is an unbroken connection.

questions.prompt: How should a trainee test whether a power supply works?
choices: Short the green and black wires with a paperclip
Open the PSU and measure inside
questions.explanation: A PSU tester is safe and shows every output voltage.
